newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. okays NYNEX competitors' discount rate.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. okays NYNEX competitors' discount rate.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commisssion said on Wednesday it approved temporary discount resale rates NYNEX Corp unit New York Telephone must offer to competitors looking to buy local telecommunications services wholesale for resale to the public.
The commission also said in a statement it approved agreements between New York Telephone and three competitors.
Under the discount rate decision, competitors would be able to buy New York Telephone's business and residential lines at 11 percent and 17 percent respectively below the retail rate.
Competitors could then resell the lines along with other services they offered to customers, the commission said.

Under the temporary decision, which takes effect October 8, NYNEX has to allow state-certified competitors to rename, reprice and market the company's local service, the commission said. NYNEX has about 91 percent of N.Y.'s total access lines.
The commission said it expects to make a decision on permanent discount rates later this autumn.
